summary:
Turn 48 closed the unread-surface list by reading the three remaining helper files and recording them as infrastructure with sources.

What was read. replica/sender.go defines a channel-based Sender type with a family of Send* helpers, and nothing outside that file references it; replica/mset.go defines the MsgSet quorum-message helper (Add/Reinit/Free) with no external caller; hook/hook.go and hook/cond.go hold a SIGUSR1 hook and a condition-variable helper that no replica, epaxos or client code references. Their presence also explains the earlier deferral reasons: the epaxos package sends through Replica.SendMsg and its own bcast functions rather than through these helpers.

Map update (accepted base version 10, additive). Three surfaces were added with new sources and an infrastructure disposition: replica/sender.go, replica/mset.go, and hook/hook.go with hook/cond.go, each stating that no caller outside the file was found in the snapshot so they carry no responsibility for the epaxos path. Nothing existing was modified, so no map_changes rationale was invented for the additions; the rationale records them as independent additions and the feedback explains them.

Remaining, recorded rather than absorbed: the deliver-time delay path in replica/defs/latency.go is still described only at the surface level, the timeout-driven recovery path remains unexercised by any check, and the scope-issue bookkeeping on the superseded C1 artifact stays visible. Audit spec version 10; the seven settled claims (six confirmed, one bounded no-violation) and the two paused candidates are untouched, and no requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened.
